title: Superpower rating line
description: A small review-score line: the score, a green star (or a row of five boxed stars) and the source, with an optional stack of round avatars before it and a member count after a dot.
notes: the star colour is chart-1 (green in the superpower theme)
name: superpower-rating

props.name: score
props.description: the score text before the star, e.g. "4.8 out of 5"

props.name: source
props.description: the source after the star, e.g. "on Verdict"

props.name: stars
props.description: star: one green star between score and source · boxed: five boxed stars first

props.name: avatars
props.description: round avatars stacked before everything (photos, or empty for placeholders)
